sn12.40:1.2: Yañca kho bhikkhave ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.40:1.4: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti ||
sn12.40:1.7: cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇam sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti || ||
sn12.40:1.8: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 4
sn12.40:2.1: No ce bhikkhave ceteti no ca pakappeti atha ce anuseti ārammaṇam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.40:2.3: Tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe nati hoti ||
sn12.40:2.6: cutūpapāte sati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti || ||
sn12.40:2.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 6
sn12.40:3.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave no ce ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti || ārammaṇam etaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ||
sn12.40:3.2: ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || 7
sn12.40:3.3: Tad appatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe nati na hoti ||
sn12.40:3.6: cutūpapāte asati āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇam soka paridevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti || ||
sn12.40:3.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhukkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
